about.title: About us
about.lead: Fundación Fénix LPB was born from the desire to transform the lives of animals in vulnerability.
about.text: We are a legally constituted nonprofit foundation, created in the city of La Paz, Bolivia, on July 28, 2020, led by its founder Ariana Castillo Illanes.
about.founder_alt: Ariana Castillo Illanes, founder, hugging a dog
about.phoenix_text: Just as the Phoenix symbolizes rebirth, we work to offer new opportunities to those dogs and cats who have been mistreated, abandoned or who live in vulnerability. We want to see them rise again, find a home where they can heal, feel loved and live the happiness they have always deserved.

pillars.title: What we do
pillars.subtitle: Our work is based on three fundamental pillars
pillars.pilar1_text: We watch over the physical and emotional health of the animals in our care, prioritizing their sterilization and general well-being as the basis for responsible adoption.
pillars.pilar2_text: Through educational programs that promote responsible ownership and foster respect and empathy towards animals.
pillars.pilar3_text: Through our “Por menos de ellos sufriendo” program directed to areas or communities with scarce access to veterinary services, contributing to reducing abandonment and animal overpopulation.
pillars.future_text: Looking to the future, we aspire to strengthen and expand this work, consolidating the mass and free sterilization program as a real and sustainable response to the problem of animals on the streets, and as the most effective path towards lasting social change.

program.title: Our program
program.paragraph1: Our main program, called “Por menos de ellos sufriendo”, is one of the strongest pillars of our work. It emerged with the objective of breaking the cycle of mistreatment, abandonment and animal overpopulation.
program.paragraph2: It consists of carrying out mass sterilization drives, totally free and without any exception: dogs and cats, males and females, purebred or mixed.
program.highlight_box: Because we believe that everyone deserves the same opportunity.
program.paragraph3: We take these drives especially to areas or communities where access to veterinary services is scarce or non-existent.
program.photo_alt: Woman holding her sterilization certificate with her dog in the aguayo

financing.title: How do we finance this program?
financing.paragraph1: Our mass sterilization drives are possible thanks to solidarity donations from our followers and from committed people who believe in our work. Their constant support is the basis that allows us to maintain this service 100% free for the animals who need it most.
financing.paragraph2: Each contribution, however small it may seem, means more sterilized animals, more suffering avoided and more hope for the benefited population.
financing.paragraph3: That is why your help really matters.
financing.photo_alt: People waiting at a sterilization drive

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Every sterilization means a life with less suffering and a future with more hope.
results.close1: Thanks to our “Por menos de ellos sufriendo” program, we have already changed the story of more than 1,000 dogs and cats, helping prevent abandonment and overpopulation.
results.close2: This program is just beginning, but early results show that change is possible and that together we can make it real. We are grateful for the support of people who trust our work and share our conviction that sterilization is one of the most effective, responsible and compassionate tools for a future with fewer animals suffering and more lives protected.

collaborate.title: How to help
collaborate.subtitle: Your support can take many forms
collaborate.donate_text: Every donation helps us cover rehabilitation, sterilization and the wellbeing of the animals in our care.
collaborate.sponsor_text: Your support sustains our “Por menos de ellos sufriendo” program and brings free sterilization drives to the communities that need them most.
collaborate.adopt_text: When you adopt, you not only change one animal's life; you also free a place in the shelter for another who needs it. If you are in La Paz, Bolivia, write to us on WhatsApp for more information.
